response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS mean_per_day_rate FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(ra.avg_length) AS avg_length, AVG(ra.avg_per_day_rate) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(ra.avg_per_day_rate - rm.mean_per_day_rate) AS avg_amount_above_mean FROM rating_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm WHERE ra.avg_per_day_rate > rm.mean_per_day_rate
